title: Theatre Review To Grandmother's House We Go

body_presentation.source_prefix:
THEATRE REVIEW TO GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE WE GO

Saturday, March 21, 1992

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Toronto ONT -- WRITTEN BY JOANNA M. GLASS Directed by John Wood Starring Rita Howell, Marion Gilsenan and Joyce Campion At the Bluma Appel Theatre Rating: This old-style family play, and a very accomplished one, contains just one surprise, whose detonation is superbly timed Grandma, what big ideas you have BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail Toronto ON Wednesday we had Brother Andre's Heart, in which a grandmother pays a call on the young folks. On Thursday it was Joanna Glass's play, which gives us, as promised in the title, the same situation in reverse. Who says the Toronto theatre lacks variety?
